replacementConfiguration.templateName: Homa thank you, Quiet authority v1

providerReadback.note: A real Handwrytten custom-card create, quality check, detail read-back, and account-owner confirmation are still required.

historicalDelivery.note: Cards already mailed with the prior template are external historical copies. They remain truthful provenance and are never described as recalled.

prerequisiteEvidence: provider custom-card create, quality check, and detail read-back
physical card crop, ink, handwriting, contrast, privacy, and recipient-experience proof
stopGeneration.reason: Do not stop generation of the current template until the replacement is provider-verified and physically inspected.

rollback.restoreAction: Restore HANDWRYTTEN_CARD_ID to the last accepted card, keep the sweep dark while checking the provider account, then redeploy the server configuration.
rollback.cacheBehavior: Public Blob cover URLs are immutable inputs to the provider record. A failed replacement remains private or unreferenced; the current card ID is not switched until read-back passes.
rollback.publicAssetMigration: Record every generated cover URL and stop using the retired URL as the current source only after the replacement has a verified provider card. Preserve required lineage privately.

restoreProof.note: A measured restore rehearsal and provider read-back are still required.

physicalProof.note: No physical Quiet authority card has been accepted yet. Inspect trim, safe area, ink, handwriting, contrast, address safety, privacy, and recipient experience before rollout.

contracts: thank_you_cards unique family id and deny-all server-only outbox
primary-parent recipient snapshot and no later-member reminting
no address inference, no child data, and no provider payload beyond the approved message
explicit live-mode and account-level test-mode safety checks
basket clear and optimistic-lock recording before any retry or restore
